# Network Fault Diagnosis

Identify, classify, or localize faults and failure causes in wireless network infrastructure or operation from observed network data.

**Aliases:** fault detection, fault classification

**Datasets in catalogue:** 3

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [SpotLight Open RAN Anomaly Dataset](../datasets/spotlight-open-ran.md) | Network KPI | Anomaly label | Measurement | Indoor, Office | Not reported | Open |
| [TelecomTS](../datasets/telecomts.md) | Network KPI, Text / natural language | Anomaly label | Hybrid | Laboratory | Mixed | Open |
